verdict.rationale: Deleting a connection or user is a fair question for a financial-data aggregation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of an item/user removal endpoint, revoking access, or purging held data. The docs cover only data products, Link, Sandbox and webhooks for Item changes, and the community post asking how to make Plaid lose access is an open question, not evidence either way.
